name: 3d-cellular-automata
description: A visual and interactive 3D cellular automaton built with [Three.js](https://threejs.org/), inspired by the birth of stars in space and concepts from the theory of computing. This project was created as an extra credit project for a computing theory class, [CSE355 @ ASU](https://catalog.apps.asu.edu/catalog/courses/courselist?subject=CSE&catalogNbr=355&term=2251&collapse=N)) and explores how simple rules can lead to complex emergent behavior.
